name: generate-image-sd
title: Local Stable Diffusion Image Generation
description: Generate high-resolution AI images via local Stable Diffusion WebUI API (SDXL on lotus:7860).

prompt.description: Visual text description of the image to generate

output.description: Destination file path for the generated image

procedure.name: generate
procedure.command: bun -e 'const host = process.env.SD_HOST || "http://lotus:7860"; const prompt = process.argv[2]; const output = process.argv[3] || "output.png"; console.log("🎨 Generating image via " + host + " [SDXL]..."); const res = await fetch(host + "/sdapi/v1/txt2img", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt, steps: 25, width: 1024, height: 1024 }) }).then(r => r.json()); if (!res.images?.[0]) { console.error("Generation failed:", res); process.exit(1); } await Bun.write(output, Buffer.from(res.images[0], "base64")); console.log("✔ Saved generated image to: " + output);' "${prompt}" "${output}"
procedure.purpose: Send text-to-image request to Stable Diffusion API and decode base64 PNG directly to target file
